title: Data processing method, client, device and computer readable storage medium

pse.problem: Low training efficiency and poor classification performance of a federal learning model due to manual labeling of private data and potential error labeling by users
pse.solution_function: Downloading pre-labeled public data from the cloud, using it to tag private data locally, training a federal learning model with labeled private data, uploading the trained model's parameters to the cloud
pse.solution_structure: Cloud (data storage and model distribution), client (private data storage, federated learning model, convolution layer)
pse.solution_implementation: Extracting a feature vector of private data using a convolution layer of the federal learning model, clustering the characteristic vectors of the private data to assign pseudo labels, training the federal learning model with pseudo-labeled private data, obtaining classifier and convolutional layer parameters for the federated learning model
pse.effect: Improved training efficiency due to pre-labeled public data and reduced error labeling by users
